name: speech
description: Offline speech recognition and voice replies. Whenever the user sends a voice note or audio file, run this plugin's transcribe tool on it first and treat the transcript as their message. If they sent a voice note or ask to hear the answer, reply with a voice note made by the speak tool; otherwise reply in text.
instructions: Models download in the background after install or update (a minute or two). Set stt_model to moonshine-tiny for faster but less accurate transcription, or tts_voice to another Piper voice, then update the plugin to download it.

stt_model.description: Speech-to-text model: moonshine-base (default, more accurate) or moonshine-tiny (about twice as fast).

tts_voice.description: Piper voice for spoken replies, for example en_US-lessac-medium (default), en_US-amy-low or en_GB-alan-medium.
